title: Hörbyån flood · November 2023
summary: The official notice reported flooding on parts of Ågatan and Tvärgatan near Skattkistans preschool. Drivers were advised to use alternative routes.
spatialCaveat: Street locations are matched to current OpenStreetMap geometry. The report does not delineate the flooded sections; markers locate the named streets, not surveyed flood boundaries.

timeline.label: Flood reported
timeline.text: Parts of Ågatan and Tvärgatan were reported submerged. Drivers were advised to choose alternative routes. A peak was expected on Saturday; this was a forecast, not a measured peak.

timeline.label: Water receding
timeline.text: The municipality reported some recession at 15:42. Barriers were expected to handle additional rainfall. Exact road reopening times were not given.

timeline.label: Recovery update
timeline.text: The 16:00 update reported substantial overnight recession and warned of loose manhole covers and uneven ground. It did not provide a verified all-clear for individual roads.

locations.nextStep: Locate the affected section and confirm drainage condition, closure duration and access requirements with the municipality.
